questions.answer: useful to you and to me

Why does Paul have much joy and comfort in Philemon's love?
options: The hearts of the saints were refreshed through him
He sent money to Paul in prison
He freed all of his servants
He built a house for the assembly

questions.q: Why would Paul do nothing without Philemon's consent?
options: So his goodness would be of free will

questions.q: If then you count me a partner, ____ as you would receive me.

Paul is confident Philemon will do even more than he asks.
